rows.query: Up to what value can a Ministry buy directly on GeM from any available supplier, without comparing sellers?
rows.answer: The maximum value limit for direct purchases on GeM without comparing sellers is up to Rs. 50,000/-, as per the rules [goods_manual_2024:4.17.2][ncs_manual_2025:4.6.3][gem_gtc_4_0:C4][gfr_2017:R149]. This limit applies to purchases made through GeM, and it is subject to the procuring authorities certifying the reasonability of rates [gem_gtc_4_0:C4].
